queries.result: First-party results identified Rajasthan's official BhuNaksha cadastral mapping portal, the Rajasthan Urban GIS portal with Khasra search, and official Rajasthan land-record integration pages. A Sri Ganganagar-specific public parcel geometry response was not obtained.

queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official Rajasthan BhuNaksha portal and a Ganganagar district plot-report route. The search results evidence cadastral-map availability at the state/district service level, but not an anonymous city-bounded ID-plus-geometry response.

registryBasis: An official Rajasthan government/NIC BhuNaksha cadastral map service is evidenced, and its public plot-report result identifies district 28 Ganganagar. This establishes a state/district cadastral map custodian, not a verified citywide open parcel API.

officialSources.observation: Official Rajasthan BhuNaksha viewer describes a public cadastral mapping interface with plot information; the page was discoverable through first-party search but direct retrieval from this environment timed out.

Official plot report is readable and identifies district 28 Ganganagar, with tehsil/village/sheet and plot identifiers. It is a Ganganagar district example, not a city-4295 geometry sample, and no owner or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.

Official Rajasthan Urban GIS portal exposes Khasra search, map viewing and land-profile functions, with a disclaimer that displayed data is for viewing only; no anonymous feature payload or schema was captured.

Official Rajasthan administrative report identifies a Land Record Section in the Office of District Collector and District Magistrate, Sri Ganganagar; this supports local custodial responsibility but is not a parcel service.
